Concession GuardrailLink

Guardrail AreaCurrent AnswerRequired Before ApprovalIf Weak or Missing
Exception classGuarded account-entry override.State that the concession is temporary, bounded, and tied to this matter.Block precedent language and keep founder review active.
Margin floorUnder review through founder concession logic.Margin floor, recovery path, claim exposure, and payment structure are visible together.Do not release or improve proforma confidence.
Expiry logicMust be explicit before the concession normalizes.Expiry at signed proforma, rejected offer, repricing decision, or validity window lapse.Treat concession as active exception risk.
Recovery logicMust show how the account returns to standard economics.Re-anchor quote or document realized recovery proof before next cycle.Escalate to exception governance.
Blocked actionsOffer may not imply supplier final allocation, shipment release, or payment clearance.Formal offer and response records carry the same blocked actions.Pull language back to controlled commercial review.
